name: Nspire
author: TIde
description: TI-Nspire CX support: completions and hover help for Nspire Lua and the Ndless SDK's C/C++ API, and commands to scaffold a Ndless project in the open folder, build it with make, pack .lua/.py scripts into .tns with Luna, and send files to the calculator panel's Nspire.

completions.label: platform.apilevel
completions.documentation: The Nspire Lua API level the script targets, declared at the top, such as platform.apilevel = '2.4'.

completions.label: on.construction
completions.documentation: Runs once when the script starts; initialize state here (the window size isn't guaranteed yet).

completions.label: on.resize
completions.documentation: Runs when the window size is known or changes; read platform.window:width()/height() here instead of hardcoding 318x212.

completions.label: on.paint
completions.documentation: Draws the screen with the gc graphics context. Set color and font before drawing; keep allocations and image.new out of here.

completions.label: on.charIn
completions.documentation: A character was typed; ch is the character.

completions.label: on.enterKey
completions.documentation: The Enter key was pressed.

completions.label: on.escapeKey
completions.documentation: The Esc key was pressed.

completions.label: on.arrowKey
completions.documentation: Touchpad arrows; arrow is "up", "down", "left" or "right".

completions.label: on.mouseDown
completions.documentation: Touchpad pressed at (x, y); on.mouseMove(x, y) and on.mouseUp(x, y) too.

completions.label: on.timer
completions.documentation: Runs on the interval set by timer.start(seconds).

completions.label: on.save
completions.documentation: Returns state to keep when the document saves; on.restore(state) receives it.

completions.label: on.restore
completions.documentation: Restores state returned by on.save.

completions.label: timer.start
completions.documentation: Calls on.timer every `seconds`.

completions.label: platform.window:invalidate
completions.documentation: Repaints the window — call it outside on.paint to trigger a redraw.

completions.label: platform.window:width
completions.documentation: Window width in pixels (318 on a CX).

completions.label: platform.window:height
completions.documentation: Window height in pixels (212 on a CX).

completions.label: var.store
completions.documentation: Stores a variable shared with the document's other pages; var.recall(name) reads it.

completions.label: var.recall
completions.documentation: Reads a variable stored with var.store.

completions.label: math.eval
completions.documentation: Evaluates an expression with the Nspire math engine; returns nil, err on failure — guard the result before using it.

completions.label: image.new
completions.documentation: Loads an image file, or creates a blank one with image.new(w, h). Create images outside on.paint.

completions.label: gc:setColorRGB
completions.documentation: Sets the drawing color; set it before every draw in on.paint.

completions.label: gc:setFont
completions.documentation: Sets the font used by gc:drawString.

completions.label: gc:drawString
completions.documentation: Draws text; pass 'top' as the anchor so (x, y) is the text's top-left corner.

completions.label: gc:fillRect
completions.documentation: Fills a rectangle with the current color.

completions.label: isKeyPressed
completions.documentation: True while the key is held; pass a KEY_NSPIRE_* constant from keys.h.

completions.label: wait_key_pressed
completions.documentation: Blocks until any key is pressed.

completions.label: any_key_pressed
completions.documentation: True if any key is currently held.

completions.label: assert_ndless_rev
completions.documentation: Exits the program unless the installed Ndless revision is at least this one (801 for recent OSes).

completions.label: lcd_incolor
completions.documentation: Switches the LCD to 16-bit color; check has_colors first (see the SDK's colors sample).

completions.label: has_colors
completions.documentation: True on color models (the CX).

completions.label: SCREEN_BASE_ADDRESS
completions.documentation: The LCD buffer: 320x240 16-bit pixels on a CX, SCREEN_BYTES_SIZE bytes long.

completions.label: SCREEN_BYTES_SIZE
completions.documentation: The LCD buffer's size in bytes.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_ESC
completions.documentation: The Esc key, for isKeyPressed. keys.h has KEY_NSPIRE_ENTER, KEY_NSPIRE_CLICK, the arrows, digits and letters too.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_ENTER
completions.documentation: The Enter key, for isKeyPressed.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_CLICK
completions.documentation: The touchpad click, for isKeyPressed.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_UP
completions.documentation: Touchpad up; also KEY_NSPIRE_DOWN, KEY_NSPIRE_LEFT, KEY_NSPIRE_RIGHT.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_MENU
completions.documentation: The menu key, for isKeyPressed.

completions.label: isKeyPressed
completions.documentation: True while the key is held; pass a KEY_NSPIRE_* constant from keys.h.

completions.label: wait_key_pressed
completions.documentation: Blocks until any key is pressed.

completions.label: any_key_pressed
completions.documentation: True if any key is currently held.

completions.label: assert_ndless_rev
completions.documentation: Exits the program unless the installed Ndless revision is at least this one (801 for recent OSes).

completions.label: lcd_incolor
completions.documentation: Switches the LCD to 16-bit color; check has_colors first. For printf and the nspireio console, link with -Wl,--nspireio in the Makefile's LDFLAGS.

completions.label: has_colors
completions.documentation: True on color models (the CX).

completions.label: SCREEN_BASE_ADDRESS
completions.documentation: The LCD buffer: 320x240 16-bit pixels on a CX, SCREEN_BYTES_SIZE bytes long.

completions.label: SCREEN_BYTES_SIZE
completions.documentation: The LCD buffer's size in bytes.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_ESC
completions.documentation: The Esc key, for isKeyPressed. keys.h has KEY_NSPIRE_ENTER, KEY_NSPIRE_CLICK, the arrows, digits and letters too.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_ENTER
completions.documentation: The Enter key, for isKeyPressed.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_CLICK
completions.documentation: The touchpad click, for isKeyPressed.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_UP
completions.documentation: Touchpad up; also KEY_NSPIRE_DOWN, KEY_NSPIRE_LEFT, KEY_NSPIRE_RIGHT.

completions.label: KEY_NSPIRE_MENU
completions.documentation: The menu key, for isKeyPressed.

hovers.contents: **gc**: the graphics context passed to `on.paint` — `setColorRGB`, `setFont`, `drawString`, `fillRect`, `drawRect`. Set the color before drawing.
**var**: `var.store(name, value)` and `var.recall(name)` share variables with the document's pages.
**image**: `image.new(path)` loads an image, `image.new(w, h)` creates a blank one. Create images outside `on.paint`.
**isKeyPressed(KEY_NSPIRE_…)** (keys.h): true while the key is held.
**wait_key_pressed()** (libndls.h): blocks until any key is pressed.
**assert_ndless_rev(n)** (libndls.h): exits unless the Ndless revision is at least n, e.g. 801.
**lcd_incolor()** (os.h): switches the LCD to 16-bit color; check `has_colors` first.
**has_colors** (os.h): true on color models, the CX.
**SCREEN_BASE_ADDRESS** (os.h): the LCD buffer, 320x240 16-bit pixels on a CX — see the SDK's colors sample.
**isKeyPressed(KEY_NSPIRE_…)** (keys.h): true while the key is held.
**wait_key_pressed()** (libndls.h): blocks until any key is pressed.
**assert_ndless_rev(n)** (libndls.h): exits unless the Ndless revision is at least n, e.g. 801.
**lcd_incolor()** (os.h): switches the LCD to 16-bit color; check `has_colors` first. For printf, link with -Wl,--nspireio.
**has_colors** (os.h): true on color models, the CX.
**SCREEN_BASE_ADDRESS** (os.h): the LCD buffer, 320x240 16-bit pixels on a CX — see the SDK's colors sample.
